text:
rachel_prod: Quick note from today's demo: the in-console Tips pane labels the feature as 'Actions' but the official docs and nav use 'Routes'. New users got hung up. Also some deep links from the pane landed at the top because anchors moved. Opening thread to sync.

sami_design: Ugh. The pane renders a raw excerpt from the docs index, so if the docs still say 'Actions' the pane shows that. We should reduce the surface area of stale copy.

jorge_docs: I can do a targeted sweep to replace remaining 'Actions' with 'Routes' in the docs, but we should also add a canonical glossary to prevent regressions.

kevin_platform: For anchors, our static generator renames hashes when headings change (punctuation, emoji). Short-term: supply a redirects.json from docs build that maps legacy hashes to canonical slugs. Client can rewrite links before opening. Example small map: {"actions":"routes","action-usage":"routes-usage"}.

rachel_prod: Can the Tips pane link open full docs in a new tab instead of a modal? Modal focus seems fragile.

sami_design: Prefer new-tab CTA to avoid focus issues. If we must keep a modal, ensure it sets aria-modal="true", role="dialog" and focus() the main H2 after mount. Also shorten the pane to title + one-line summary so less stale text gets surfaced.

jorge_docs: I'll add canonical_slug frontmatter for critical headings so slugs are stable. Also will emit redirects.json during the next build. I'll include a small banner when a redirect happens: "Redirected from legacy link " to be explicit.

kevin_platform: On the client side I'll implement a docs.redirect(hash) helper that returns {finalHash, redirected}. We'll emit a telemetry event docs_deeplink_redirect with originalHash and finalHash. Also add a feature flag to toggle rewriting in case of issues.

rachel_prod: Can we also incrementally sanitize pane excerpts at render time? A tiny replace map for surface mismatches (e.g., 'credit units' -> 'units') would let us patch quickly.

sami_design: Client replace OK as a quick patch, but be careful with grammar. We'll prefer build-time canonicalization for long term.

jorge_docs: Agreed. Plan: 1) short-term: client replace map + new-tab CTA, 2) next docs build: canonical_slug + redirects.json + banner, 3) client: redirect helper + telemetry, 4) a11y: modal focus if still used.

a11y-bot: a11y: If modal remains, ensure keyboard focus moves into it, Escape closes and returns focus to trigger, visible focus outline on heading, and contrast ratio >=4.5 for snippet text in both themes. Also validate using a screen reader that the heading is announced.

kevin_platform: I'll draft the client SDK change behind a feature flag and include telemetry.

jorge_docs: I'll open a docs PR with the canonical glossary and a sample redirects.json.

sami_design: I'll update the Tips pane to title+blurb+open-icon, adjust colors for contrast, and add copy notes to avoid ambiguous words like 'credit units'.

deploy-bot: docs-site: PR #904 opened by jorge_docs  "canonical-slugs + redirects" (labels: docs, a11y).

rachel_prod: Great. Timeline: PRs by Wednesday, canary Thursday. Please @me on PRs. Thanks everyone — small fix but will reduce onboarding friction.
